name: Beijing Strong Biotechnologies,Inc.
summary: Beijing Strong Biotechnologies,Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) products and services in China and internationally. It provides biochemistry reagents, including liver, renal, lipid, cardiac, diabetes, special protein, tumor marker, pancreas, inorganic, inflammation, TDM, and other panels; and coagulation products, such as prothrombin time, activated partial thromboplastin time, thrombin time, and fibrinogen, as well as antithrombin III, von Willebrand factor antigen, protein S activity, protein C, lupus anticoagulant, fibrin degradation products, and d-dimer.
